name: Chunk 1/28

raw_entities.name: Customer Identification Policy
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank's formal policy governing customer identification and Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures. The policy is owned by the Head of Compliance and applies to all staff, branch managers, compliance, and risk personnel. It is mandated by FCA COBS Part 10 and the Money Laundering Regulations 2017, and was effective from 2026-01-15 with a scheduled review date of 2027-01-15.

raw_entities.description: Financial Conduct Authority regulation governing conduct of business rules, specifically Part 10, which addresses customer identification and Know Your Customer requirements. This regulation mandates the Customer Identification Policy.
context: Regulatory Reference | FCA COBS Part 10, Money Laundering Regulations 2017

raw_entities.description: UK legislation establishing anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing obligations, including customer identification and due diligence requirements. This regulation mandates the Customer Identification Policy.

raw_entities.name: Head of Compliance
raw_entities.description: The designated policy owner responsible for the Customer Identification Policy. The Head of Compliance holds accountability for policy governance, maintenance, and compliance oversight.
